0022600193.text: The Golden State Warriors (6-3, on a six-game winning streak) host the Orlando Magic (2-6, on a three-game losing streak) in the Warriors' 10th game of the season. Golden State is 2nd in the Pacific, one game back, and 8th in the West, going 4-1 at home and 2-2 on the road, while Orlando is 12th in the East, 0-4 at home, 2-2 on the road, and 5th in the Southeast, three games back, with Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) all out. For Golden State, Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery) are out, while Draymond Green (elbow inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf), and Gui Santos (knee) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; the teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, having split 1-1 in 2025-26, and the Warriors won their last meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
